_comment: First-party Immersive Engineering compat (IEPLAN #34) — the deep/precious IE metals (deepslate bauxite/aluminum, silver, uranium) on the deepslate-bodied ancient mining island; complements the rocky family (aluminum/lead/nickel). IE physical ores never worldgen in the void, so this is a hand-mining path. Inert without IE. First-pass counts — throw-test + tune like #71. Bands merge into ancient's max_y:20 / min_y:96 bands (selectors match ancient.json) so the veins don't vanish on low/high throws, per quark_ancient.json. Mirror to immersiveengineering_ancient_large.json + immersiveengineering_huge_ancient.json.

biome_overrides._comment: …into the deep band (max_y 20) — deepslate metals + an uncommon crude-oil pocket near bedrock (Immersive Petroleum lore); else it replaces the ore list. Oil is a small deep_core vein of source blocks, walled by the stone body — pump with the IE Fluid Pump. Inert without IP (unknown ore skipped before RNG). This is the void's crude-oil path since IP reservoirs don't generate (decoration skipped).
